# Migration (Experian & Twitch)
Date: 2026-10-09 | Duration: 30.75m

## Summary
The team is refining migration strategies and customer messaging for Anthropic, Twitch, Experian, and other large customers. Anthropic’s full cutover takes 10 weeks, involving thousands of feature flags and about 1,000 metrics, while Twitch has experienced migrations lasting nearly a year and Experian has 12 holdouts planned for next year. EPO’s open-source SDK can manage holdouts with lower hashing risk and offline support, with custom scripts available if needed. Dropbox’s reported full adoption demonstrates enterprise-scale capability. Growth Book is positioned against Datadog and in-house platforms through its open-source core, scalability, realistic commitments, direct engineering access, white-glove onboarding, and self-hosting options. One-to-one mapping of metrics and flags, existing customer event pipelines, and phased analytics-first adoption can reduce migration friction. The team also plans to address customer-specific gaps, such as Anthropic’s daily participation metrics, prepare concise migration summaries, coordinate pricing around projected usage, and use leadership and in-person engagement to build trust.

## Keywords
migration, holdouts, EPO importer, white glove onboarding, open source, Datadog
